description_en: Queries the Virtual Border Routers (VBRs) under a specified Express Connect circuit, including VBRs owned by the circuit owner and VBRs owned by other accounts
description_zh: 查询指定物理专线下的边界路由器（VBR），包括物理专线所有者的VBR和其他账号的VBR
name: DescribeVirtualBorderRoutersForPhysicalConnection

parameters.help_en: The region where the Express Connect circuit resides. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 物理专线所在的地域。 您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html 接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Express Connect circuit
parameters.name: physical_connection_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为50。默认值为10。
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en:
The filter condition. You can specify up to 5 filter conditions. The following filter conditions are supported:

PhysicalConnectionId: instance ID of the Express Connect circuit instance.

VbrId: instance ID of the Virtual Border Router instance.

Status: the status of the Virtual Border Router.

Name: the name of the Virtual Border Router.

AccessPointId: instance ID of the access point.

eccId: instance ID of the Express Cloud Connect instance.

type: the type of the Virtual Border Router
fields.help_zh:
过滤条件，最多可提供5个过滤条件。支持如下过滤条件：

PhysicalConnectionId：物理专线实例ID。

VbrId：边界路由器实例ID。

Status：边界路由器状态。

Name：边界路由器名称。

AccessPointId：接入点ID。

eccId：高速上云服务实例ID。

type：边界路由器类型
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The filter values based on the specified Key. You can specify multiple filter values for a single Key. The relationship between multiple filter values is OR, which means that a match with any one of the filter values is considered a match for the filter condition
fields.help_zh: 根据Key指定过滤值。一个Key支持指定多个过滤值，每个过滤值之间是或的关系，即只要符合其中一个过滤值，则视为匹配该过滤条件
fields.name: value

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值：50。默认值：10

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries in the list

VirtualBorderRouterForPhysicalConnection.description_en: The collection of queried VBR instance information
VirtualBorderRouterForPhysicalConnection.description_zh: 查询到的VBR实例信息合集

ActivationTime.description_en: The time when the VBR was first activated. The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format, where Z indicates UTC
ActivationTime.description_zh: VBR第一次激活的时间。按ISO 8601标准表示，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ，其中Z表示UTC时间

Bandwidth.description_en: The bandwidth value of the Virtual Border Router bound to the Express Connect circuit. Unit: Mbit/s
Bandwidth.description_zh: 物理专线下绑定的边界路由器带宽值，单位：Mbps

BandwidthStatus.description_en:
The bandwidth status. Valid values:

Active: Normal.

Inactive: abnormal
BandwidthStatus.description_zh:
带宽生效状态。取值：

Active：正常。

Inactive：异常

CircuitCode.description_en: The circuit code provided by the carrier for the Express Connect circuit
CircuitCode.description_zh: 运营商为物理专线提供的电路编码

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the VBR was created. The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format, where Z indicates UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 创建VBR的时间。按ISO 8601标准表示，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ，其中Z表示UTC时间

EccId.description_en: The instance ID of the Express Cloud Connect instance

EnableIpv6.description_en:
Indicates whether IPv6 is enabled. Valid values:

true: enabled.

false: disabled
EnableIpv6.description_zh:
是否启用IPv6。取值：

true：开启。

false：关闭

LocalGatewayIp.description_en: The IPv4 address on the Alibaba Cloud side of the VBR instance
LocalGatewayIp.description_zh: VBR实例的阿里云侧互联IPv4地址

LocalIpv6GatewayIp.description_en: The IPv6 address on the Alibaba Cloud side of the VBR instance
LocalIpv6GatewayIp.description_zh: VBR实例的阿里云侧互联IPv6地址

PConnVbrBussinessStatus.description_en:
The business status of the VBR bound to the Express Connect circuit. Valid values:

Normal: Normal.

FinancialLocked: financial lock
PConnVbrBussinessStatus.description_zh:
物理专线绑定的VBR运行状态。取值：

Normal：正常。

FinancialLocked：欠费锁定

PConnVbrChargeType.description_en:
The billing method of the Virtual Border Router bound to the Express Connect circuit. Valid values:

PrePaid: subscription. If you select this billing method, make sure that your account supports balance payment or credit payment.

PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
PConnVbrChargeType.description_zh:
物理专线绑定的边界路由器付费类型。取值：

PrePaid：预付费，包年包月。选择该类付费方式时，您必须确认自己的账号支持余额支付或信用支付。

PostPaid：按量付费

PConnVbrExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the VBR bound to the Express Connect circuit. The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format, where Z indicates UTC
PConnVbrExpireTime.description_zh: 物理专线绑定的VBR到期时间。按ISO 8601标准表示，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ，其中Z表示UTC时间

PeerGatewayIp.description_en: The IPv4 address on the customer side of the VBR instance
PeerGatewayIp.description_zh: VBR实例的客户侧互联IPv4地址

PeerIpv6GatewayIp.description_en:
The IPv6 address on the customer side of the VBR instance.

This parameter is required when creating a VBR instance for the Express Connect circuit owner, and is not required when creating a VBR instance for other accounts
PeerIpv6GatewayIp.description_zh:
VBR实例的客户侧互联IPv6地址。


为物理专线所有者创建VBR实例时必填，为其他账号创建VBR实例时无需填写

PeeringIpv6SubnetMask.description_en:
The subnet mask for the IPv6 addresses on the Alibaba Cloud side and the customer side of the VBR instance. 

The two IPv6 addresses must be in the same subnet
PeeringIpv6SubnetMask.description_zh:
VBR实例的阿里云侧和客户侧互联IPv6的子网掩码。 

两个IPv6地址必须位于同一个子网。

PeeringSubnetMask.description_en:
The subnet mask for the IPv4 addresses on the Alibaba Cloud side and the customer side of the VBR instance.

The two IPv4 addresses must be in the same subnet
PeeringSubnetMask.description_zh:
VBR实例的阿里云侧和客户侧互联IPv4的子网掩码。

两个IPv4地址必须位于同一个子网

RecoveryTime.description_en: The most recent time when the VBR was recovered from the Terminated state to the Active state. The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format, where Z indicates UTC
RecoveryTime.description_zh: VBR最近一次从Terminated状态恢复到Active状态的时间。按ISO 8601标准表示，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ，其中Z表示UTC时间

Status.description_en:
The instance status of the VBR. Valid values:
         
unconfirmed: waiting for confirmation from another party.

active: Normal.   

terminating: being stopped.  

terminated: stopped.   

recovering: being recovered.   

deleting: being deleted
Status.description_zh:
VBR实例状态。取值：
         
unconfirmed：等待他人确认。

active：正常。   

terminating：终止接入中。  

terminated：已终止接入。   

recovering：恢复中。   

deleting：删除中

TerminationTime.description_en: The most recent time when the VBR was terminated. The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format, where Z indicates UTC
TerminationTime.description_zh: VBR最近一次被终止的时间。按ISO 8601标准表示，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ，其中Z表示UTC时间

VbrId.description_en: The instance ID of the VBR

VbrName.description_en: The name of the VBR instance

VbrOwnerUid.description_en:
The account ID of the VBR owner.

This parameter is empty when the VBR and the Express Connect circuit have the same owner
VbrOwnerUid.description_zh:
VBR所有者的账号ID。

VBR和物理专线的所有者相同时该参数为空

VlanId.description_en: The VLAN ID of the VBR instance
